scope: Task-specific native runtime roles and enhancements beyond OpenHands; no universal winner or automatic alternate installation.

discovery.meaning: Discovery coverage reported by the bounded read-only research wave, not 352 accepted runtimes.

architecture.trigger: Consequential choice of multiple runtime/framework roles and persisted state, with conflicting source/package version evidence.
architecture.decision: Retain qualified native Codex/Dagu; separately qualify OpenHands CLI/SDK and a DeepAgents persistent-research candidate; OpenAI SandboxAgent remains a valid source-reviewed alternate.
architecture.acceptance: Source-level architecture accepted for isolated scoped trials; execution/default promotion depends on original native results.

enhancement_policy: Give each native worker an explicit task/role/model/effort, owned workspace/state, bounded lifecycle and deterministic task oracle.
Load the task's source-pinned skills and selected MCP tools progressively; optional extensions qualify independently.
Use native caching, compaction/condenser, supported checkpoint and provider formats; preserve all failed attempts and unknown counters.
Parent native sign-ins and provider routes remain native; selected framework requests use child-scoped OmniRoute20128 Responses.
A framework source review, install, unchanged upstream test and live provider run are different evidence classes.
